40/S0.subgoal: Explain what navigation means in an immersive experience and identify its travel and wayfinding components.

40/S1.subgoal: Describe the travel or locomotion part of navigation, including exploration, search, maneuvering, and the four locomotion categories.

40/S2.subgoal: Describe walking-based locomotion and its full-gait, partial-gait, and gait-negation techniques.

40/S3.subgoal: Describe steering-based locomotion and its spatial and physical steering subtypes.

40/S4.subgoal: Describe selection-based and manipulation-based locomotion techniques.

40/S5.subgoal: Explain wayfinding and the design supports that help users build a mental map.

40/S6.subgoal: Describe interaction for system control and summarize the lecture’s main points.
